findings.title: Version checks race with unconditional writes

evidence.detail: The expected version is checked before the write.
The update omits expected version and state predicates.

findings.impact: Concurrent instances can overwrite each other and emit duplicate success audits.
findings.remediation: Lock before reading and enforce predicates in the update.

findings.title: Reconciliation can mutate closed-period transactions

evidence.detail: Only the statement date is checked against the close date.

findings.impact: Later statements can reconcile closed-period history.

evidence.detail: Identity components are joined with an unescaped colon.

findings.title: Malformed quoted CSV is accepted
findings.impact: Malformed quoting may become transaction data.
findings.remediation: Use strict parsing and stable errors.

findings.title: CSV imports have no resource bound

evidence.detail: Every parsed row accumulates in memory.

findings.title: Accepted integers can exceed SQLite storage

evidence.detail: Every non-boolean Python int is accepted.

findings.impact: Public inputs can leak overflow errors.

report.security_posture: Parameterized SQL and no secret/network surface; unbounded CSV allows local denial of service.
report.strongest_quality: State and audit writes share SQLite transaction contexts.
report.weakest_quality: Concurrency and closed-period invariants are not completely enforced.

evidence.detail: Transitions are localized but checks are separated from writes.
Operations use direct descriptive control flow.
One bounded ledger class owns behavior.
Closed-date comparison is shared but applicability is caller-owned.
Visible version checks are not atomic.
Domain errors are stable but overflow escapes.
Tests omit concurrency and closed reconciliation.
No lifecycle, contention, or recovery contract.

overall_readiness.rationale: Concurrency and closed-period reconciliation violate financial invariants.

conditions: Use strict bounded input and unambiguous IDs.
take_production_ownership.rationale: Direct code, but invariant defects block ownership.

test_confidence.supplied: Five tests establish basic persistence, versions, import retry, reconciliation, reversal, close, and audits.

correctness.detail: Concurrency, closure, identity, parsing, and range gaps exist.

failure_atomicity.detail: Parsing precedes writes and state plus audit share transactions.

input_boundaries.detail: CSV and integer boundaries are incomplete.

settings.tools: read candidate; run only supplied sandbox command
